title: Whole-range lumbopelvic ratio (lumbar RoF / pelvic RoF) at full forward flexion, by sex and age

quantity.name: lumbopelvic ratio L/P (full flexion)
quantity.definition: full lumbar RoF / full pelvic (sacral) RoF from standing to max flexion. Lumbar angle = sum of Epionics segments lordotic in standing (lordosis negative, kyphosis positive); sacrum orientation = accelerometer angle vs gravity (pelvis surrogate). Full RoF = value at max (lumbar+sacrum) minus standing. Phase L/P = incremental lumbar change / incremental sacral change over 0-33% (early), 33-66% (middle), 66-100% (late) of total flexion (sum of both angles).

source.authors: Pries E, Dreischarf M, Bashkuev M, Putzier M, Schmidt H
source.sample: asymptomatic volunteers, BMI<26, age 20-75 (subset of the Consmuller 2012 cohort of 429); age groups 20-35 (n=155), 36-50 (n=100), >50 (n=54) (file K02_Pries2015.pdf)

protocol.summary: Whole-range L/P at maximal flexion; entire cohort from Table 1 (ratio of mean RoFs), sex medians Table 3, sex x age medians Table 2.
how_to_use: At full flexion split lumbar+pelvis motion as lumbar = L/P/(1+L/P); entire cohort 0.72 -> lumbar 42%, pelvis 58% (skin-surface lumbar angle, sacral accelerometer).
Use the sex/age medians to adapt the end-of-range split: males 20-35 0.91 down to 0.65 for males >50; females ~0.65-0.70 at all ages.
For the time course within flexion use lp_ratio_phases (the ratio is not constant).

measurement.device: Epionics SPINE: 2 paravertebral strain-gauge strips (12 x 2.5 cm segments) 7.5 cm lateral of midline + tri-axial accelerometer at PSIS level (sacrum orientation)
measurement.task: 5 x maximal upper-body forward flexion from relaxed standing at preferred speed

protocol.notes: Table 1 entire-cohort value 0.72 equals 52.1/72.1 (ratio of means); sex/age values are medians (range). Note Epionics pelvic RoF (72 deg) is larger and L/P smaller than marker/IMU studies with T12/L1-S1 lumbar definitions (e.g. Tafazzol 1.14).

extraction.check_notes: Rechecked against rendered Tables 2-3; abstract states decrease 0.80 to 0.65 with age (cohort).

pass_rule.rule: input data – not graded; use for robustness checks
